description: The provided image displays two horizontal bar charts, both titled "Marco-o1-7B," comparing inference times (in minutes) across five different methods: Baseline, Fast-Solving Prompt, SFT, DPO, and O1-Pruner. The bars are color-coded and labeled in a legend at the bottom of each chart. The charts are arranged side-by-side, with the right chart showing generally longer inference times than the left chart.
